notes: These are the seed defaults loaded when the website initializes
Update the defaultRuns IDs if you want different baseline comparisons
Update defaultSettings to change the default assets

startDate/endDate here are NOT the Run Backtest modal's period: /config/defaults overrides them with the latest settled US trading week (provider.default_backtest_window). They still describe the defaultRuns seed runs, and the Trading Algo panel (algo_service) still reads them
The frontend will load these values if no other runs are available
